G1.4_matching_groups.rule: diff pair: identical W, L, nf, m; mirror: same L and model (ratio allowed)

G1.6_resistance_sensitivity_vs_spice.note: matched terminals varied symmetrically. Pass = SPICE slopes consistent between 20 and 100 ohm (or first-order prediction within 5 % of the margin at 100 ohm) AND the linear model explains the change: either directly (small-signal) or when re-solved at the operating point SPICE finds with the resistor inserted (bias shift).
